name: Codeanywhere
description_en:
Codeanywhere is a product in the IDEs category. Its directory profile covers Refactoring, Syntax Highlighting, Code Completion, Real-time Collaboration, Debugger, Source code editor, Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $4.80.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Codeanywhere 属于集成开发环境软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括代码重构、语法高亮、代码补全、实时协作、调试器、源代码编辑器、版本控制。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $4.80.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在编写过程中提供代码补全建议；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official home, pricing and docs now redirect to a vendor sunset announcement dated June7,2026: new signups closed, July1,2026 service shutdown, export deadline and cessation of recurring charges. The announced closure date has passed; live account/data recoverability was not probed. Current operational docs and purchasable plan are unavailable, so old directory features/prices are not adopted as current and the record is not counted as a completed operating-service profile. Actual announcement URLs/hashes retained in batch notes.
